youtube.title: The Till Was Over by the Same Sum Every Friday (Mystery Story)
youtube.description:
Every Friday, the till was forty-seven dollars over. Iris found out why, and the owner did not want her to count it again.

An invented mystery about a night clerk, a corner bakery, and a customer who always pays too much. Nobody gets hurt: the puzzle is where the money comes from and what a ledger can hide. Fiction only.
